newsitem.title: UK: LME copper fails to hold above $1,900 by close.
newsitem.headline: LME copper fails to hold above $1,900 by close.

text.p: COPPER - Fails to hold above $1,900 level by end of kerb after flip-flopping during day. Ends at $1,896, down $22.
ALUMINIUM - Settles easier at $1,352 by close, but trade buying keeps it off fresh 2-1/4 year lows. ALLOY - Weaker.
NICKEL - Barely higher, supported by mine closure.
LEAD - Ends touch firmer. TIN/ZINC - Off slightly.
